text.name: Euro Cash
text.rules: Record "single currency". If "union founded" has been recorded this game, LIO spends 2 points on one action; otherwise, LIO spends 1 point on actions. At the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point on actions.
text.history: Euro notes and coins entered circulation on 1 January 2002 in twelve EU countries with around 300 million people.
